{{Spoiler}}

'''Gnocchi''' is a secret potato pasta that heals {{Hp|16}}, tied with [[stroganoff]] for the most healing of any crafted meal. It has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/gnocchi.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[baked potato]], [[cheese]], an egg, [[flour]] and a [[bowl]]. The recipe is taught by a [[Cooking Recipe]] found in mineshaft chests.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating gnocchi takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|16}}. The bowl is given back. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
